content.text:
I submitted **index 3 (Fe 0.79 / Sb 0.21)**. At 0.464% EQE it was the best of the three compositions I measured. That used the whole merit budget; I used 2 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Fe / Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.85 / 0.15 | 0.369 |
| **3** | **0.79 / 0.21** | **0.464** |
| 12 | 0.49 / 0.51 | 0.0056 |

- **Trend:** EQE is far lower near the 1:1 composition than on the iron-rich side, so I spent the last measurement on the iron-rich side. It came in about 25% above the iron-rich end of the library (index 0), so the best value is somewhere inside the range, not at the edge.
- **Structure:** the XRD patterns for index 0 and index 4 look like iron oxide (hematite) mixed with a second phase, probably FeSbO₄. The second phase shows up more strongly at index 4. I didn't run the tool that checks the patterns against reference phases, so that identification is a guess from peak positions.
- **Not measured:** nothing between indices 1–2 or 4–11 was measured, so the true best could be a neighbour of index 3. The antimony-rich half of the library (indices 13–29) was also left unmeasured, on the assumption that EQE keeps falling as antimony increases.
